authority.scope: preparation and artificial unit/interface checks plus exact delta review only

training.loss: mass mean squared damage plus ell^2 GP gradient squared; full graph one transition per update
training.initialization: head weight zero/bias .05; four64 residual message blocks

criteria.role: prospective synthetic single-family online acceleration claim; all physical acceptance and f<1 coverage necessary
criteria.rationale: accuracy-first 0.1 percent mean normalized field agreement and1percent worst-step cap;10percent time reduction is a practical margin, not a confidence bound; no old criterion changed
criteria.timing_uncertainty: single matched whole-trajectory timing; no statistical repeatability claim
criteria.scoring_timing: all reference comparisons are posthoc analysis; excluded from matched online CF/CC/CH and fully charged as study evaluation work

stopping: first unaccepted state/time/RAM/storage/identity failure stops whole pipeline; no partial fit/resume/retry or threshold/eta change
interpretation: old c1 fields are replay only; state0 is prescribed; newly accepted same-contract trajectory states alone form labels; test opens only after model frozen

stopping_details.meaning: 120s is cooperative solver deadline and watchdog trigger, not an exact OS kill instant. Phase, shared-analysis, total-host and GPU triggers subtract45s to charge polling and termination within their envelopes. Slow filesystem/OS scheduling can delay supervision; actual elapsed including cleanup is always reported, no absolute realtime guarantee.

input_identity_revision: portable fixed-order native Q4 B/det; original scientific state arrays bitwise unchanged, derivation in inputs.json; no threshold change

method_revision.mechanics: same hybrid-only warm mechanics workspace and exact-key LU policy in reference/classical/NN phases; caches isolated by phase
method_revision.active_set: trace signs reconstructed from BC-projected/scaled previous u; not accepted truth
method_revision.reuse: fixed geometry/material tensors and CSR scatter; numeric LU only exact CSC/free-DOF identity; no separate SuperLU symbolic reuse claim
method_revision.audit: uncached legacy final mechanical assembly plus unchanged fresh joint residual/KKT and immutable accepted-history map
method_revision.durable_observability: start/end fsync per block, separate Linux pidfd controller and gated worker start; report incomplete work after kill
method_revision.matched_quality: classical and hybrid must BOTH satisfy unchanged quality limits before joint matched-quality acceleration claim
method_revision.posthoc: sealed-state raw/active, energies/trace branches, fronts/support, feasibility/healing, correction/fallback and fixed4/304/599/600 field maps, separate evaluation cost

cost_basis.interpretation: single accepted-step sensitivity only; not a full-trajectory prediction or measured speedup. Substep2 cost split unknown. Six/six allocation proposed within total12GPUh, not approved execution.
